query: In my Stellar dapp I want to call a smart contract and send an XLM payment in the same transaction so both happen atomically. Show me how to build it with the JS SDK.
expected_behavior: Says a smart contract transaction can hold only one operation (invokeHostFunction, extendFootprintTtl or restoreFootprint)
Does not build a transaction that adds a payment or other classic operation next to contract.call
Notes that prepareTransaction/assembleTransaction rejects the mixed transaction and the network rejects it as malformed
Offers a working path: move the transfer into the contract call (e.g. via the native SAC) for atomicity, or send two separate transactions
